rules.name: cosmic_dimension_vs_being_layer
rules.condition: D4 mapped to human stage or layer without explicit distinct typing
rules.canonical_guard: cosmic D4 = ruh/melekler; human stages/layers are not numerically identical
rules.false_positive_guard: do not flag quoted legacy usage when explicitly marked historical or disputed

rules.name: center_analogy_not_ontological_proof
rules.condition: geometric or coordination center presented as proof of ontological origin
rules.false_positive_guard: legitimate analogy with explicit scope and limitations is allowed

rules.name: procedure_not_legitimacy
rules.condition: presence of procedures treated as sufficient proof of normative legitimacy
rules.false_positive_guard: candidate necessary conditions or explicit objections are allowed

rules.name: information_access_not_verification
rules.condition: information access or number of approvals equated to independent correctness
rules.false_positive_guard: documented source independence and evidence evaluation are distinct and allowed

rules.name: rasterast_not_only_binary_filter
rules.condition: full Rasterast process reduced to only pass/fail without source genealogy, common error, or revision where broad meaning intended
rules.false_positive_guard: a local filter is allowed when explicitly scoped as one sub-operation

policy.publication_requires: 412 distinct articles, canonical consistency, independent K0-K6 checks and founder approval
